channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Here’s Block Club Chicago’s Annual Bucket List To Get You Through The Rest Of Winter
item.description: There’s lots you can do during Chicago's bleakest season. Our staffers offer their favorite ways to make the most of winter.

item.title: Lakeview Neighbors Rattled By Fatal Carjacking
item.description: Neighbors say the early morning shooting that killed a 22-year-old man was unsettling as they typically feel safe in the area. Investigators have linked the stolen car to a second fatal shooting in Bronzeville an hour later.

item.title: Woman Dies After Being Found Inside Car In Roscoe Village
item.description: A 39-year-old woman was found "unresponsive" but still breathing Thursday afternoon in a car on Damen Avenue, according to police and media reports. She was pronounced dead at Illinois Masonic.

item.title: Man Beaten And Robbed At Gunpoint In Fulton Market, Police Say
item.description: The attack took place in broad daylight Thursday on Peoria Street and was caught on camera.

item.title: Mayor Vetoes Controversial Ban On Intoxicating Hemp Products
item.description: Mayor Brandon Johnson has long backed hemp businesses, pointing to minority operators locked out of the state’s limited legal cannabis rollout. His veto — the second of his term — now puts him at odds with City Council.

item.title: Federal Judge Rules Against ICE Over Memo That Expanded Power To Make Warrantless Arrests
item.description: U.S. District Judge Jeffrey Cummings ruled Friday afternoon that immigration agents must follow the Castañon Nava consent decree, which is still in effect, ruling against an ICE memo that expanded agents' ability to make warrantless arrest.

item.title: Ofelia Torres, Teen With Cancer Who Fought For Father’s Freedom From ICE, Has Died
item.description: Torres, 16, died Friday. Her father was arrested in October, the day after she returned from more than a month at the hospital for cancer treatments. She shared her family's plight, and her was father freed.

item.title: Chicago Could Set Record-High Temperature Monday As Warm Stretch Continues
item.description: Monday's forecast high of 64 degrees could set a record for highest temperature for Feb. 16. The warm stretch comes after one of the coldest periods in recent city history.

item.title: Teen Wanted In South Side Jewel Triple Shooting Arrested In Phoenix, Police Say
item.description: Elijah Theodore, 19, has been charged with attempted murder in a theft at the Jewel-Osco Near 33rd Street and King Drive that ended in three people being shot, according to police.

item.title: A West Side Mailman Went Viral For Singing To A Widowed Grandmother. It Changed His Life
item.description: Postal worker Lavonte Harvey's singing while on his mail route was caught on the doorbell video camera of an Austin grandmother, who was so delighted she shared the video with her influencer granddaughter. The viral video led neighbors to help Harvey buy a car.
